Welcome to
PedalLario!

A real 22 km cycling route around Lake Como, Italy. Along the way are 6 physical totems like the one next to you, each one marks a place with a story.

Tap a totem and unlock a story

At every totem, riders hold their phone against an NFC sensor. The app instantly unlocks a digital medal and the history of that exact spot.

  1. Reach a totem
  2. →
  3. Tap your phone
  4. →
  5. Unlock the medal

Collect all 6 medals and the loop is complete, then choose your reward: a story to share on social media, a poster or postcard to print at home.

Now
it’s your turn

The app assumes you already cycled from Lecco and collected 5 medals along the way. The totem beside you is Pescarenico, the last stop.

Look around the app freely, when you open the map and reach Pescarenico, you’ll find a button to collect the last medal. This totem doesn’t have a real NFC sensor, so that button simply simulates it.
